messages:
Noah Patel: Heads-up 
We're running a microtest for landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Small scope: hero headline variants, one-line benchmark, two CTAs, and the inbound routing rule. Freeze for design handoff Fri noon.
Lina Gomez: Love it. Keep Hosted hero lightweight for devs. Avoid too many numbers in hero.
Sam - copy: Drafting micro-headlines now. Will aim for clear differentiation between modes.
Riley (growth): Routing: default mapping Hosted -> signup funnel (self-serve), Dedicated -> demo/AE, Private -> AE + security intro. Immediate AE if message or company description contains "enterprise", "on-prem", or compliance terms.
Sam - copy: Hosted hero candidates:
- "Hosted API: start building in minutes"
- "Low-latency hosted inference, no infra ops"
Hosted benchmark line options:
- "Typical 99th-pct latency <200ms on common workloads"
- "Benchmarks: sub-200ms 99th on many production flows (details)",
Lina Gomez: Second feels fine if we link to a bench page.
Sam - copy: Dedicated headline candidates:
- "Dedicated GPU pools for predictable throughput"
- "Reserve capacity, control cost"
Dedicated micro-callout: "SLA-backed uptime and configurable autoscale."
Sam - copy: Private headline candidates:
- "Private deployment: VPC & on-prem"
- "Customer-managed network and keys"
Sam - copy: CTAs (A/B):
Hosted: ["Create free account", "See performance tests"]
Dedicated: ["Request capacity review", "Get bespoke pricing"]
Private: ["Talk to sales", "Request security brief"]
Riley (growth): Add UTM pattern: ?utm_source=site&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=tri_mode_test&utm_content=variantX. We'll map utm_content -> SFDC lead route.
InfraBot: NOTE: Dedicated throughput stat placeholder -> "~200k tokens/sec cluster (varies)". Confirm with infra.
Noah Patel: Webinar tie-in for Hosted: 30-min demo + live benchmarks. Headline: "Live demo: cut inference cost with batching & caching". Include calendar CTA.
Lina Gomez: Also propose a microtest: show "benchmark badge" (e.g., "sub-200ms 99th") on Hosted hero vs control without badge. Measure conversion uplift.
Sam - copy: I'll post final copy drafts (hero, subline, two CTAs) in this thread in 3 hours. Keep copy lean.
Riley (growth): I'll add the routing YAML + UTM -> queue mapping after copy pass.
Noah Patel: Perfect. Design handoff Fri 12:00 PT. Small, measurable iterations. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
